description: Circuit du Canal du Rhône au Rhin is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Grand Belfort. Trace of the 12 hiking circuits of the Grand Belfort. Coverage: Grand Belfort. The portal shows the English title as "Rhone-Rhine Canal Circuit" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Grand Belfort. Its keywords include donnees-ouvertes, circuits-touristiques, tourisme, sentiers-de-randonnee, geospatial. The listing shows 6 download or service links in ZIP, KML, WEB PAGE, CSV. The listing shows 2024-04-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
